item.text: {"explanation":"A resumable receiver stores one active transfer, its declared length, and known byte positions. Valid chunks are checked before mutation; conflicting overlaps reject the entire chunk. Finishing exposes data only when all positions are known.","mapping":"The active transfer maps to state.id and state.len; byte conservation maps to state.b, where null means unknown and non-null entries are retained across events.","assumptions":"Inputs follow the stated JSON limits. Invalid operations produce invalid status while preserving active state; mismatched IDs produce ignored status.","applies":"function applies(input){return true}","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||x.data!==null&&x.status!==\"complete\")return false;if(![\"ok\",\"ignored\",\"invalid\",\"conflict\",\"incomplete\",\"complete\"].includes(x.status))return false;if(typeof x.received!==\"number\"||x.received<0)return false}return true}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){const max=config.maxLength;let s=state||{id:null,len:0,b:[]};const out=st=>({data:null,id:s.id,received:s.b.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x!==null),0),status:st});const same=(a,b)=>a===b;let t=event&&event.type;if(t==='begin'){let n=event.length;if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>max)return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};if(s.id===null||!same(s.id,event.id)){s={id:event.id,len:n,b:Array(n).fill(null)};return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}if(s.len!==n)return{state:s,output:out('conflict')};return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}if(s.id===null||!same(event&&event.id,s.id))return{state:s,output:out('ignored')};if(t==='finish'){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);let o=out(complete?'complete':'incomplete');if(complete)o.data=s.b.slice();return{state:s,output:o}}if(t!=='chunk')return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};let a=event.bytes,o=event.offset;if(!Array.isArray(a)||!Number.isInteger(o)||o<0||o+a.length>s.len||!Number.isInteger(event.checksum)||a.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255)||a.reduce((q,x)=>q+x,0)%251!==event.checksum)return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(s.b[o+i]!==null&&s.b[o+i]!==a[i])return{state:s,output:out('conflict')};for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)s.b[o+i]=a[i];return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}"}
